review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure based in Canada. We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to help build and operate large-scale infrastructure supporting multiple digital content products. You will join a team of senior and principal engineers responsible for a unified content storage and governance platform, working with hundreds of billions of objects and serving hundreds of millions of users every month. The role combines hands-on Rust development, Python tooling, distributed systems, and data infrastructure. You will own features and services throughout their lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to deployment and production operations. Working closely with machine learning, search, product, and data teams, you will help shape technical direction and enable other engineers to build reliably on the platform. This is an opportunity to solve complex storage, performance, and governance challenges in a remote-first environment that values technical ownership, collaboration, and thoughtful engineering practices. Accountabilities Build and evolve core infrastructure: Design, develop, and operate features within core Rust services, including transactional storage, transformation coordination, and low-latency data retrieval systems operating at massive scale. Own projects end to end: Lead initiatives from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing production operations. Establish performance plans, observability practices, on-call readiness, and incident response processes. Improve developer tooling and experience: Evolve the Python userland, including transformation frameworks and internal tools. Support engineers building on the platform through code reviews, technical guidance, integration support, and clear documentation. Drive cross-functional initiatives: Partner with machine learning, search, product, and data teams to define project scope, estimates, and milestones. Coordinate delivery, resolve technical dependencies, and contribute to the broader engineering roadmap. Optimize performance and infrastructure costs: Improve query execution, Parquet file layouts, S3 access patterns, caching strategies, and PostgreSQL/Aurora queries. Use production metrics and operational data to prioritize improvements. Strengthen data governance and security: Develop platform capabilities for data lineage, authorization, access control, and deletion propagation across products. Apply security-first principles to system design and implementation. Raise engineering standards: Contribute through thoughtful code reviews, mentorship, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. Explore and pilot agentic AI workflows while maintaining human oversight, code quality, security, and accountability. Requirements Professional software engineering experience: At least 7 years of experience building backend, distributed, or data-intensive systems in production environments. Rust and Python proficiency: Hands-on experience writing Rust through professional work, open-source contributions, or personal projects, alongside strong Python development skills. Storage and data fundamentals: Solid understanding of object storage such as Amazon S3, relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, and columnar data formats such as Apache Parquet or Arrow. Production systems expertise: Experience building and operating high-throughput services, including monitoring, metrics, tracing, alerting, performance troubleshooting, and production debugging. End-to-end project ownership: Demonstrated ability to take projects from design documentation through delivery, break complex work into milestones, coordinate with stakeholders, and mentor less experienced engineers. Cloud and infrastructure experience: Practical experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora, as well as infrastructure-as-code tools and workflows such as Terraform. Communication and collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped, delivered solutions. Preferred Qualifications Rust data ecosystem experience: Familiarity with Apache DataFusion, arrow-rs, the Parquet crate, query engines, or database internals. Open-source contributions: Contributions to open-source projects, particularly within the Rust data ecosystem, such as Delta Lake, Arrow, or DataFusion. Data governance knowledge: Experience implementing data lineage, access controls, and regulatory deletion or privacy compliance, including GDPR-related requirements. Cloud cost optimization: A track record of reducing infrastructure costs through engineering improvements such as better file layouts, caching, or storage tiering. Developer platform experience: Experience building SDKs, client libraries, or developer tools used by other engineering teams. Agentic AI development practices: Recent hands-on experience incorporating agentic engineering tools, such as Claude Code, into daily development workflows while retaining human review and responsibility for quality and security. Benefits Location and flexibility: Remote work through a flexible work model, with occasional in-person attendance required. Employees must be primarily based in or near an eligible city in Canada, the United States, or Mexico. Eligible Canadian locations include Ottawa, Toronto, and Vancouver. Canadian salary range: CAD $159,000–$210,500, depending on geographic location, experience, skills, education, and other relevant factors. Equity: Eligibility for competitive employee equity ownership. Healthcare: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage. Wellbeing and protection: Mental health support and disability coverage. Time off: Generous paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, winter break, volunteer time, and sabbatical opportunities. Family support: Paid parental leave and family-related benefits. Financial benefits: Retirement contribution matching. Learning and development: Professional growth opportunities and learning programs. Additional support: Wellness and home office stipends. Product access: Complimentary access to the company's suite of products. Technology resources: Enterprise access to leading AI tools.
